title: Convenience Shops
content:
[vc_row][vc_column][smartslider3 slider="32"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Convenience Shops"]

The College has an in-house convenience shop for the use of all the students of College, this convenience shop is a retail shop which stocks range of everyday stationeries that is useful for all the students. The Convenience shop has all the books, equipment’s, tools etc., to fulfill the stationery needs of Students.

The College has also a dedicated Photo-copying machine for its students for bulk copying of books. Notes, reports etc., It has also a DTP Centre and courier corner to help students design their project reports and communicate through mails on time.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
